conventions.frame_identity: c_s(tau, ubar) = F_{u_s}(tau) + pi log Im tau + C, C = -2 pi (gamma + log pi), u_s = coords(ubar) + h_s
conventions.line_of_character: the summed twist ubar with real coordinates Jc; channels add h_s = 0, (0,1/2), (1/2,0), (1/2,1/2)
conventions.apex: the highest lift of the closed geodesic (reduced), the record's apex (B1720)
conventions.windows: one period, t0 = -l/2 and t0 = -l/2 + 0.37 l, 48 nodes
